# Standalone coherent nominal basis rows

The closed project uses an ordinary enum in a classical helper called by a
coherent basis expression. The expected result is Bit 1. The selected source
uses a rectangular Unit-to-three-state lift and requires physical label 2.
Neither program contains a coherent selection.

The original first attempts are unchanged. The baseline CLI observations
come from the earlier retained windows and timestamps are the stdout file
write times. The executable paths were reused between builds. The later
checks report the standalone original basis profile; the run returns Bit 1.
